gaps.explanation: The schedule is 448,968 above the statement. Detail takes the business-type outflows from the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Funds (p10, printed p45): 'Charges to appropriations' Electric 6,264,147 + Water 370,346 + Sewer 415,635 = Total business-type 7,050,128. These are budgetary-basis outflows: they leave out depreciation and include capital and debt payments. The statement figure is the accrual-basis Proprietary Funds statement (p7, printed p18): Total operating expenses 6,590,384 (including depreciation 347,226) + Interest expense 10,776 = 6,601,160 (also printed on the Statement of Activities, p2). Both printed totals are correct on their own basis. No line is missing or duplicated, so there is nothing to fix.
